page.overview:
What is Alleyway between Magnolia Crescent and Wisteria Walk?

There was a narrow, poorly illuminated alleyway linking Magnolia Crescent and Wisteria Walk in the town of Little Whinging, Surrey. It was located between the garage of 2 Magnolia Crescent and a high fence.

On 6 August 1993, this alleyway was where Harry Potter first saw Sirius Black in his Animagus dog form.

On 2 August 1995, this alley was also the location of the Dementor attack on Harry Potter and Dudley Dursley.
